notes: Local raw-input fixture for Phase 2G. This is an offline sample for converter validation only; it is not scraped, fetched, or used by the app runtime.

source.label: MTA Greenpoint Av station context sources

identityName.rationale: Reviewed official transit context supports the Greenpoint Av G station-area identity used by the review cue.

categoryBusinessType.rationale: The current evidence supports transit context for review, but does not define a product-copy business/category claim.
categoryBusinessType.neededEvidence: A reviewed transit/place taxonomy claim or approved manual review row for the category copy field.

addressLocation.rationale: The current evidence supports station-area context, not an exact address, entrance, or station-footprint location.
addressLocation.neededEvidence: Reviewed station entrance/location evidence that separates exact entrance claims from symbolic scene placement.

storefrontFacade.rationale: A subway cue is not a storefront/facade claim, and current evidence does not support exact visual station geometry.
storefrontFacade.neededEvidence: Approved transit visual-reference evidence and a reviewed claim boundary for any product-facing station visual claim.

entranceFrontageGeometry.rationale: The current evidence explicitly does not resolve exact stair, elevator, entrance, frontage, or station-footprint geometry.
entranceFrontageGeometry.neededEvidence: Reviewed entrance-coordinate or station-geometry evidence plus Batu-approved representation rules.

confidence.rationale: Supports Greenpoint Av G station-area context at Manhattan Ave and Greenpoint Ave; does not support exact entrance coordinates or station geometry.

claims.notes: Supports station-area context used by the review-only transit cue.

claims.value: Review-scale cue on the Greenpoint Ave side
claims.notes: MTA context does not resolve exact stair, elevator, entrance, or station-footprint geometry.

qaNotes: Official transit sources are used for station-area context only.

remainingGaps: Exact entrance coordinates, stair alignment, station footprint, and production transit mapping remain blocked.
